issues.description: FR3 and FR4 are untested by the mutation harness (no mutant specifically targeting them), though they are present and enforced in grader.py.
issues.evidence: per_requirement_coverage shows FR3 and FR4 covered:false, mutants_targeting:0

recommendations: Add a mutant/test case specifically targeting FR3 (e.g., tied max confidence) and FR4 (e.g., summary omitting integrity keyword) to raise coverage confidence for these functional requirements.
Consider adding an explicit negative test where the vulnerable/naive submission has confidence >=0.5 but wrong leak identification, to further validate SR1/SR2 discrimination independent of FR3.
